study type: Cohort study (secondary analysis of a dietary randomized controlled trial)
exposure: maternal visceral adipose tissue (VAT) volume during pregnancy
change in maternal VAT volume from GW 15 to birth
cohort: The study included 119 pregnant women with a pre-pregnancy body mass index ranging from 28-45 kg/m2 and their offspring.
finding: Maternal visceral adipose tissue (VAT) during pregnancy and its change were associated with offspring insulin concentrations and birthweight, suggesting an influence on the fetal metabolic environment and potentially fetal growth.
